evidence: Clicking API filter reduced list to 5 API docs; clicking All restored full 20-doc list across all modules.
Selected REST API Design Guidelines: shows title, description, date 2024-01-15, version v2.3.0, 3 content sections, and 4 related documents.
Clicking expanded 'REST Principles' header collapsed it: body paragraph disappeared and reference links lost cursor-pointer/interactivity, while the section header remained clickable to reopen.
Re-clicking 'REST Principles' header restored the body paragraph and reference links (with cursor-pointer/clickable state) exactly as before collapse.
Chevron icon has 'rotate-180' class when section expanded (body visible) and no rotate class when collapsed (body hidden); indicator state matches visibility.

Viewing 'REST API Design Guidelines': neither its content-section references (API Versioning Strategy, Error Handling Standards, HTTP Methods Guide) nor its Related Documents list (API Versioning Strategy, Error Handling Standards, HTTP Methods Guide, Rate Limiting) include itself.

From expanded 'Endpoint Naming Conventions' section, clicking 'HTTP Methods Guide' reference navigated the document view to the HTTP Methods Guide document (title, description, sections, related docs updated accordingly).

Clicking 'HTTP Methods Guide' link while its section was collapsed kept 'REST API Design Guidelines' open and showed toast 'Please expand the section to access links'. After expanding the section, clicking the same link navigated to the HTTP Methods Guide document.

Clicking a graph node (REST API Design Guidelines) added a pulsing glow ring (class 'animate-pulse-glow') and thicker stroke-width (3 vs 2) as selection indicator. Zoom In changed indicator from 100% to 120%; Reset View restored it to 100%.

Graph rendered 19 document nodes (matching the 19 documents in the Documents list across all 5 modules) and 19 connection lines for related-document relationships; Reset View control brings the full graph back to 100% zoom/default pan.

One graph node exists per document (19 nodes for 19 documents), each node's stroke/fill color corresponds to its module (5 distinct module colors matching legend: API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System), and 19 lines connect nodes representing related-document relationships.

issue: Graph node click does not open document view
actual: Single-clicking and double-clicking document nodes in the Knowledge Graph (e.g. Rate Limiting, OAuth 2.0 Integration, Role-Based Access Control) only applies a visual selection highlight (pulse-glow ring) to the node. The active tab remains 'Knowledge Graph' (nav button class stays bg-primary) and no document view/content is opened; there is no navigation to the Documents tab or any embedded document panel shown.

evidence: App exposes Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites nav buttons; clicking each switches the active view (verified via nav 'active'/bg-primary class and distinct main content for each).

With 'Role-Based Access Control' selected, 'Role Hierarchy' collapsed and 'Permission Model' expanded, and graph zoomed to 120% with a node selected: switching Documents→Favorites→Knowledge Graph→Documents preserved the same document, same section collapse/expand states, and the graph's 120% zoom plus the previously selected node (glow) intact.

issue: Favorites view incorrectly filtered by stale module filter after reload
actual: Favorited "REST API Design Guidelines" (API) and "Role-Based Access Control" (Authentication); nav badge correctly showed "Favorites 2" and localStorage correctly retained favorites: ["rbac-system","rest-api-design"] plus selectedModule:"api". Real-time count update, and marker persistence through in-session filtering/sorting all passed. However, after a full page reload, the Documents module filter "API" was itself restored from persisted state, and switching to the Favorites tab in this state showed only 1 of 2 favorited documents (REST API Design Guidelines) - "Role-Based Access Control" (Authentication module) was missing from the Favorites list even though the nav badge said "2". Only after manually resetting the Documents module filter to "All" did the Favorites view show both favorited documents. This contradicts the requirement that "the Favorites view continues to expose every favorited document regardless of a module filter used in Documents" - the behavior held correctly within a live session but broke immediately after a reload.
evidence: Post-reload localStorage: favorites:["rbac-system","rest-api-design"], selectedModule:"api". Favorites tab snapshot post-reload showed only REST API Design Guidelines card; after clicking "All" filter in Documents tab, Favorites tab then showed both REST API Design Guidelines and Role-Based Access Control.

Typing a non-matching search term ("zzznonexistentquery123") with module=All displayed a clear "No documents found" / "Try adjusting your search or filter criteria" message. With module filter set to "API" and search term "OAuth" (which only matches an Authentication-module doc), the same no-results message appeared. Clearing the search input in both cases immediately restored the correct document list: full 20-doc list when module=All, and the 5 API-module documents when module=API filter was still active.
